verses.english: Linked Discourses 11.8
Chapter One
Verocana, Lord of Titans
Near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove.

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno.
verses.english: Now at that time the Buddha had gone into retreat for the day’s meditation.

verses.pali: Atha kho sakko ca devānamindo verocano ca asurindo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā paccekaṁ dvārabāhaṁ nissāya aṭṭhaṁsu.
verses.english: Then Sakka, lord of gods, and Verocana, lord of titans, approached the Buddha and stationed themselves one by each door-post.

verses.pali: Atha kho verocano asurindo bhagavato santike imaṁ gāthaṁ abhāsi:
verses.english: Then Verocana spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“A man should make an effort
until his goal is accomplished.
A goal is splendid when accomplished—
this is the word of Verocana!”
“A man should make an effort
until his goal is accomplished.
For the goal that’s splendid when accomplished,
naught better than patience is found.”
“All beings are in need,
as they deserve in each case.
But even so, harnessed work is the highest
thing of value for all living creatures.
A goal is splendid when accomplished—
this is the word of Verocana!”
“All beings are in need,
as they deserve in each case.
But rather than harnessed work being the highest
thing of value for all living creatures,
for the goal that’s splendid when accomplished,
naught better than patience is found.”
